[[Shiro's Blades]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] traded by [[Adept of Shadows]], a [[collector]] in the [[Divine Path]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 13 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 3
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item has a unique [[skin]].

==Unique Counterparts==
[[Deldrimor Blades]] and [[Droknar's Blades]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they require 9 Dagger Mastery.

[[Chkkr's Pincers]], [[Claws of the Kinslayer]], [[Faveo's Daggers]], and [[Stygian Daggers]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict Piercing damage and require 9 Dagger Mastery.

==Notes==
*Initially, these daggers had the requirement of 15 Dagger Mastery.

== Trivia ==
*Shiro's Blades are slightly shorter than [[Shiro's Sword]].
*These blades are the same as shown in the Guild Wars Factions trailer.
*These blades look very similar to a [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flyssa Flyssa]
